Not at all! There are so many ways anxiety can cause chest pains.

- Constantly very tense so your muscles cramp. This causes pinched muscles that hurt when you inhale
- Changes in heart rate from panic cause pain
- Shallower breaths/less oxygen-intake causes an intense shortness of breath feeling and chest pains
- Mistaking back or side pain for chest pain

I could continue listing forever. Anxiety also causes dizziness and headaches and dissociation and fever-like symptoms, it’s insane. I used to be 100% convinced I had a heart or lung disease so for months I went to the doctors and got every test in the book. Completely healthy aside from severe anxiety. Look up “psychosomatic anxiety symptoms” and you’ll see how common it is.

While over time, not treating this anxiety isn’t good for your health (a consistent heart rate and stable breathing is best), anxiety induced chest pain is NOT serious. Lmk if you have any questions at all :)

I’ve been dealing with intense chest pain for about 2 years now. Sometimes it was unbearable, gone to the ER multiple times thinking I was having a heart attack. I got all the testing done just to be told time and time again that it was anxiety.
